paper_hypothesis_assessment.wording: The relative benefit of progressively richer TSN traffic-shaping treatments over Strict Priority grows with offered load and burst alignment, with no single treatment dominating all load/alignment/metric combinations.
paper_hypothesis_assessment.evidence: C0 changes from 30/30 viable at L3/A0 to 0/30 at L3/A1; C1 passes 30/30 in both; calibrated CBS (paper C2) passes 0/120 at L0/L1 and 59/60 at L2; joint CBS/TAS (paper C3) has only a partial official cutoff.
paper_hypothesis_assessment.limitation: The C3 (paper) campaign is incomplete, C2 nominal is not a treatment, C0/C1 software differs, and C2/C3 are complete-policy contrasts.

scientific_claim_candidates.claim: Source pre-shaping prevents the aligned high-load camera loss/incomplete-image failure observed under SP.
scientific_claim_candidates.evidence_location: paired_contrasts C1-C0; L3/A1; F02/F05 packet and image metrics
scientific_claim_candidates.novelty_limit: Automotive QoS/pre-shaping itself is established; novelty depends on the zonal workload, paired alignment experiment and image-completion evidence.

scientific_claim_candidates.claim: Load-scaled calibrated CBS did not preserve low-load viability in this campaign configuration.
scientific_claim_candidates.evidence_location: paper C2 = historic C3 coverage L0/L1 and queue/drop metrics
scientific_claim_candidates.novelty_limit: No C2 nominal contrast; causal contribution of scaling and transient load is not isolated.

scientific_claim_candidates.claim: A fixed C4 candidate is promising at low load, with a substantial brake-tail cost relative to C3.
scientific_claim_candidates.evidence_location: paper C3 = historic C4 cutoff L0/A0 and L0/A1 plus paired C4-C2 rows
scientific_claim_candidates.novelty_limit: Official C4 is incomplete; high-load effects remain unknown and C4-C3 is a full-policy comparison.

limitations: C4 is the fixed cutoff of 90 completed_valid rows at 2026-10-27T16:43:14-03:00; the failed technical attempt and any later ledger rows are excluded.
C1 imported archive reports are paired only where per-run calendar signatures match; the current on-disk calendar CSVs were regenerated and are not substitutes for historical run signatures.
For packet flows, deadline misses include packet loss as specified by each report. Camera image-completion metrics are kept separate from packet latency.
Queue stability summaries are run-level validator outputs; they do not prove asymptotic stability.
C4 synchronization is sample-based in the included reports; continuous conformance remains not verified.
Paper C2 maps to historical campaign C3 (calibrated CBS); the nominal CBS treatment is not included in the paper comparison, so calibration superiority over nominal is not evaluated.
